## M5 Emergency
High-priority path. ALWAYS notifies staff (⚠️ email) even with partial info — so urgent cases are never missed. Staff SMS is sent via M9 (gated by sms_enabled_staff). Never diagnoses; advises urgent medical care on red-flag symptoms. Upserts to Escalations (urgency high).
After import: point 'Upsert Escalation'→M7, 'Notify Staff (URGENT)'→M8, 'Staff Emergency SMS'→M9.
